item.title: North Star Health Alliance files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy
item.description: North Star Health Alliance and three Northern New York healthcare affiliates filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection to stabilize their finances, resulting in 120 layoffs and inoperable local clinics, due to a dispute with the New York State Department of Health over withheld funds.

item.title: Shock for US figure skating, but big win for hockey in Friday Olympic competitions
item.description: Figure skater Ilia Malinin finished in eighth place in the men's figure skating final in Milan on Friday after falling twice during his routine. In hockey, the United States women's team defeated Italy 6-0 to maintain a perfect 4-0 record heading into the quarterfinals.
